title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance Plan Schedule: Subscription Fees, Term and Waiting Period
content:
## Keyturn Roadside Assistance — subscription schedule

A Keyturn Roadside Assistance subscription runs for a term of the length shown in the schedule below.
The fee for one month of cover and the fee for one year of cover paid up front are both set out for
each plan, as is the one-off activation fee charged to start the subscription. The waiting period is
the number of calendar days after activation before cover may be used, and the minimum term is the
shortest period the subscription must run.

| Plan | Fee for one month of cover (USD) | Fee for one year paid up front (USD) | One-off activation fee (USD) | Term (calendar days) | Minimum term (calendar days) | Waiting period (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | 6.95 | 69.00 | 0.00 | 365 | 90 | 7 |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | 11.95 | 119.00 | 0.00 | 365 | 90 | 5 |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | 17.95 | 179.00 | 0.00 | 365 | 120 | 5 |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | 19.95 | 199.00 | 0.00 | 365 | 120 | 5 |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | 34.95 | 349.00 | 0.00 | 365 | 180 | 3 |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | 54.95 | 549.00 | 95.00 | 365 | 180 | 0 |

### Notes on the schedule

1. The term is the same length on every plan, at 365 calendar days.
2. An activation fee is carried by Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover alone, at USD 95.00; on the other
   five plans the activation fee stands at USD 0.00.
3. The shortest period the subscription must run is 90 calendar days on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover
   and Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover, 120 calendar days on Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn
   Roadside EV Cover, and 180 calendar days on Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and Keyturn Roadside
   Concierge Cover.
4. The waiting period stands at 7 calendar days on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover, at 5 calendar days on
   Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover, Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, at 3
   calendar days on Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover, and at 0 calendar days on Keyturn Roadside
   Concierge Cover.
